How I work

A simple process that keeps your pages consistent.

  1. 01

    Plan

    Learn your brand and audience, then map a monthly content calendar around your offers.

  2. 02

    Create

    Design graphics, edit reels, and write captions in your brand’s voice.

  3. 03

    Manage

    Post on schedule, reply to comments and messages, and report what worked.

What I do

A small set of services, done consistently.

Content planning

A monthly calendar built around your offers, your audience, and the days they’re online.

Posts and captions

Graphics, short videos, and captions written in your brand’s voice.

Community management

Replies to comments and messages quickly and kindly, so followers feel heard.

Reels and short videos

Short-form videos edited in CapCut and Canva, made to hold attention and fit your brand.
